outlook.statement: Improving macroeconomic indicators and rising investor activity point toward a positive outlook. Recent upticks in daily trading volumes, new account openings, and SIP engagement reflect renewed optimism. Ongoing policy reforms are projected to stimulate investor participation—especially in direct equity markets and through financial products—positioning Market Creators Limited for strategic growth through its integrated service model.
